name: Rizuhble's Night Night Haze
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-10,400 (levels 1-17). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bullet Dance T2. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Fleetfoot, vitality 4.8k at Veil Walker.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 22 to Sleep Dagger's damage (2.20x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Fleetfoot completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Fleetfoot completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Active Reload
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Fleetfoot completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Fleetfoot completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Fleetfoot completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Fleetfoot completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Fleetfoot
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage. Temporary, sold when you buy Unstoppable later.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Veil Walker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 10,400-22,400 (levels 17-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Sleep Dagger T3, Bullet Dance T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Sleep Dagger, damage) grows from 133 to 251. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Bullet Resist Shredder.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Imbued on Sleep Dagger: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +61.6 on its damage (2.20x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell it for a second counter.

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 22,400-44,800 (levels 26-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Fixation T3.

items.name: Capacitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Fire it at whoever you're about to ult: they can't dash or use movement items.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Active Reload.
sections.desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Active Reload.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry wins the 1v1: Wraith, Vindicta, Grey Talon.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their frontline stacks bullet resist, like Bullet Resilience, and your gun stops doing damage.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell Active Reload for this, or Burst Fire if it's gone.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
